**Concept of Mole and Chemical Counting**

**Problem:**
Find out the percent composition of aluminum, sulfur, and oxygen in Al2(SO4)3.

**Solution:**
The molecular mass of Al2(SO4)3 = 27 × 2 + (32 × 1 + 16 × 4) × 3 = 342
The percent composition of Al = 27 × 2 × 100 / 342 = 15.78%
The percent composition of S = 32 × 3 × 100 / 342 = 28.07%
The percent composition of O = 16 × 12 × 100 / 342 = 56.14%
